description: Generate a random number in a range (kind number, from and to, default 1 to 6), a colour as #rrggbb (color), a GUID (guid), a password of 6 to 128 characters (password, length, default 12) or a passphrase of 2 to 12 word groups (passphrase, groups, default 4), which comes with its entropy in bits. For a UUID use generate_uuid. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
name: generate_random
title: Generate a random value
